scope: Independent critic review, four separate F-to-A grades, B+ minimum in every category, actionable builder feedback and an enforced release gate.

intuitiveness.evidence: AGENTS links the complete developer journey: declare the feature, provide evidence, obtain independent grades, fix feedback and request another review. The report schema, local command and feature-specific HOLD messages are clear. Independent execution demonstrated that tests can succeed while pending real features still return a nonzero gate result. Proportionate evidence expectations for tooling are now explicit.

accuracy.evidence: Independently rebuilt and ran all 26 native regression cases, covering every category's B floor, accepted A/A-/B+, missing grades or evidence, self-review, unresolved blockers, rejected and pending decisions, changed inputs and scope, LF/CRLF fingerprints and malformed registry/path cases. The separate critic-written Pascal traversal probe now rejects both previously accepted escaping report pointers. Read all nine declared inputs, confirmed exact input-set comparison and current fingerprints, and inspected CI acceptance wiring. Identity authentication and deliberately omitted scope are honestly outside the checker's capability. Hosted GitHub execution has not been claimed.

wowFactor.evidence: Assessed as developer tooling: the feature demonstrably turns review decisions into useful, repeatable enforcement rather than a decorative scoring rubric. Its real initial rejection led to a concrete fix and new regressions. Successful build evidence can remain available while acceptance stays held; Pages configure/upload inspect the critic outcome, and deployment requires both build and critic-gate. This evaluation does not imply audio, visual or whole-product quality.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: The implementation combines independent qualitative review, a strict per-category threshold, durable failure history and LF-normalized source fingerprints with separate build and acceptance jobs. This makes stale or incomplete approval actionable without replacing critic judgment with aggregate scores or adding unnecessary machinery. The documented builder/critic boundary is preserved in practice: the builder fixed the defect and the critic owns these revised grades.
